author: samsam78800
quote: Sad, just sad. 13 years for that? How the hell that game got 99%? Metacritic needs to do something about the fake number by the critics. The game is full of bugs, capped at 30fps (and lots of dip below 20). Unplayable. And more than everything else, this is not a GTA game, this is a stupid life simulation. It's sad to see such a wonderfull licence die, trying to avoir the "cancel culture". But GTA was always against everything and Always been controversial. That's what was appeling.
